about: Starter strength routine library (6.102.0). One row per routine (kind lift_lib), shown in the Lifts tab's Routine picker. The routine a person is on lives only in coach/strength.json (lift_routine); its id matches a row here, and that row is the one preselected and marked Recommended. A pick saved on the dashboard (store doc lift_pref/routine) is a request: the coach runs the routine change checks and the person's preferences, then moves them over at the next morning check-in. The five full body ones cover squat, hinge, push, pull and core twice a week; they differ in equipment and minutes. Calf care (the athlete, Nov 17, 2026) is the short calf routine the coach puts on 3 days a week during a calf or Achilles flare and leads with for 8 weeks after a calf strain, soleus first (coach/engine/RULES.md section 6; LIBRARY IR-39, IR-40, TR-29): a week.json strength row with "routine": "calf_care" opens it that day.
